content: Timefold 1.16.0 release: (1) JSpecify null-marking added across public API; (2) custom Move implementations no longer need to implement an explicit undo -- the framework auto-generates it (Move interface undo methods deprecated), matching AbstractMove.doMoveOnGenuineVariables behavior already relied on in this project; (3) ConstraintAnalysis.matchCount() behavior changed re ScoreAnalysisFetchPolicy; (4) new docs site. No changes to PlanningEntity/PlanningVariable/PlanningListVariable/ShadowVariable/ValueRangeProvider APIs at 1.16.0. Confirmed via GitHub release notes and docs.timefold.ai upgrade guide (1.15.0->1.16.0 section).
